mapper.select: SELECT c.CATEGORY_NAME FROM CATEGORIES c, QUIZ_SESSIONS qs,SUBJECTS s,MEMBER m WHERE c.CATEGORY_ID = s.CATEGORY_ID AND qs.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND qs.MEMBER_NUM = #{num}

SELECT q.quiz_id AS "quiz_id", q.quiz_question AS "question", q.quiz_selections AS "options", qr.quiz_user_response AS "user_answer", q.quiz_correct_answer AS "correct_answer", 'false' AS "is_correct", q.quiz_explanation AS "explanation" FROM quiz_responses qr JOIN quizzes q ON qr.quiz_id = q.quiz_id WHERE qr.selfstudy_results_id = #{resultId} AND qr.quiz_correct = 'N'

SELECT SELFSTUDY_RESULTS_ID AS "resultId", SELFSTUDY_RESULTS_ID AS "round", SELFSTUDY_TOTAL_SCORE AS "score", TO_CHAR(SUBMITTED_AT, 'MM-DD') AS "date" FROM SELFSTUDY_RESULTS WHERE MEMBER_NUM = #{memberNum} ORDER BY SUBMITTED_AT ASC

SELECT c.CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId", c.CATEGORY_NAME AS "categoryName", COUNT(sr.SELFSTUDY_RESULTS_ID) AS "totalAttempts", NVL(AVG(sr.SELFSTUDY_TOTAL_SCORE), 0) AS "averageScore", MAX(sr.SELFSTUDY_TOTAL_SCORE) AS "maxScore", MIN(sr.SELFSTUDY_TOTAL_SCORE) AS "minScore" FROM SELFSTUDY_RESULTS sr JOIN QUIZ_SESSIONS qs ON sr.QUIZ_SESSION_ID = qs.QUIZ_SESSION_ID JOIN SUBJECTS s ON qs.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES c ON s.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE sr.MEMBER_NUM = #{memberNum} GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_NAME ASC

SELECT SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID AS "subjectId", s.SUBJECT_NAME AS "name", COUNT(qr.QUIZ_RESPONSES_ID) AS "value" FROM QUIZ_RESPONSES qr JOIN QUIZZES q ON qr.QUIZ_ID = q.QUIZ_ID JOIN QUIZ_SESSIONS qs ON q.QUIZ_SESSION_ID = qs.QUIZ_SESSION_ID JOIN SUBJECTS s ON qs.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES c ON s.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE qs.MEMBER_NUM = 1 AND qr.QUIZ_CORRECT = 'N' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_NAME;
